{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOVMdNDs8AAAABZe5d-Q", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4BnXy5zhDGGUc", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4BnXy5", "number": 35, "title": "Restore complete SDEF Demo acceptance in Chromium CI", "body": "## Problem

The built SDEF Demo acceptance introduced by #33 times out on final PR-head CI. [Job 120634196219](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/actions/runs/40017782133/job/120634196219) reports 49 Node passes and 176 successful SDEF GPU comparisons, followed by 13 browser passes, one SDEF Demo failure and two optional skips. The Demo exceeds 180 seconds at `tests/browser/sdef.spec.ts:26` during `locator.screenshot()`.

The log ends while waiting for element stability. It does not identify the rig/motion/source iteration or establish whether cumulative workload, rendering, layout or synchronization caused the failure. Successful numerical conformance does not satisfy the missing interactive acceptance.

## Expected outcome

Make the complete built SDEF Demo matrix pass through the existing Chromium/SwiftShader workflow, with identifiable scenarios, measured phase durations and reliable observation of the requested rendered state. Correct demonstrated Demo/runtime defects or harness scheduling problems within this scope.

VMD animation AND VPD poses remain mandatory. All other agreed dimensions, including remaining deformation, IK/append, physics, scene animation and representative fidelity, remain required overall work.

## Context

Baseline: `a7e464a9e61916d4adf76a0747e145dcae3bfcc0`; clean local HEAD matches remote `main`. Open Issue and PR collections are empty.

`tests/browser/sdef.spec.ts` places both rigs × both combined motions × three source paths in one 180-second Demo test. The 420-second override applies only to its separate GPU test. `examples/rig.ts` reports transform/control state before the next animation-loop render; fixed 100 ms waits do not establish that screenshots contain the requested state.

Pinned [Playwright 1.56.1 screenshot code](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/blob/v1.56.1/packages/playwright-core/src/server/screenshotter.ts) performs visibility/stability waiting before capture. This explains the logged operation, not its underlying cause. Official [Three.js r186 renderer source](https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/blob/r186/src/renderers/common/Renderer.js) informs renderer lifecycle; exact npm 0.186.1 byte equivalence was not established.

[PR #34](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/pull/34) separately reports a local 49-test/14-browser pass. Saved validation retains an earlier 47-test checkpoint. Preserve those historical records and distinguish them from hosted execution. Merged-commit CI was still executing browser checks when inspected.

Dependencies remain Three.js 0.186.1, mmd-parser 1.1.4, glTF Transform 4.5.1 and Playwright 1.56.1. Use existing tooling and attributed synthetic assets.

## Pre-merge acceptance

- [ ] Identify each rig/motion/source and action phase in failure output using existing Playwright facilities. Record durations sufficient to distinguish loading, rendering, screenshot waiting and cumulative test-budget exhaustion. Document the evidence-supported cause and correction.

- [ ] Ensure screenshots observe the selected rig, motion, fractional time and appearance after rendering that state. Preserve normal interactive behavior. Add a focused regression for the demonstrated defect; do not substitute status text alone for rendered evidence.

- [ ] Complete all 12 rig/motion/source combinations, retaining both VPD poses, BDEF2 comparison and restoration, Toon/PBR and Outline changes, fractional seeking, reset, VMD/VPD handoff, morph controls and invalid-file recovery. Partition scenarios if useful, preserving lifecycle coverage and scenario identity. Any timeout adjustment must have measured workload justification; no increased global timeout, retries or skips merely to conceal failure.

- [ ] Preserve existing numerical and raster acceptance: CPU `2e-6 m`, GPU position `1e-4 m`, normalized-normal component `5e-4`, and the existing two-level/128-pixel raster budget. Retain the 176 independent SDEF comparisons and existing Gene/BDEF/VMD/VPD/morph/Toon/Outline regressions without relaxed thresholds.

- [ ] The Coordinator records final-revision results for `npm run build`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm test`, `PLAYWRIGHT_CHROMIUM_CHANNEL=chromium npm run test:browser`, `npm run check:links` and `git diff --check`, following documented setup and the pinned lockfile. The normal PR-triggered CI must demonstrate complete repaired Demo acceptance. Update validation records with revision, environment, timings, failures and skips. Testing and ordinary PR review remain Coordinator responsibilities; add no independent AI re-review or post-merge rerun.

- [ ] Preserve justified specification/converter/plugin conventions. If primary evidence corrects an AI-authored assumption or criterion, retain the old assumption, corrected requirement, source and rationale in the Issue/PR. No human approval or independent AI re-review is required; unfinished implementation or failing tests cannot justify weaker acceptance.

## Optional validation

Existing optional native-WebGPU coverage may provide additional evidence when an adapter is available. It does not replace mandatory Chromium/SwiftShader acceptance or establish original-MMD fidelity.

## Required post-merge verification

None required.

## Specification reconciliation

This task was authored by AI under the agreed MMD/glTF model, VMD animation and
VPD pose reproduction goal. Correct erroneous technical assumptions or acceptance
criteria when primary specifications or measured evidence establish the correction.
Update this Issue and record the original
assumption, corrected requirement, primary reference and rationale in the PR.
These technical corrections require neither human approval nor an independent AI
re-review. Preserve the agreed goal and relevant pre-merge acceptance; do not weaken
requirements merely to accommodate incomplete implementation or failing tests.
